request.style: English, jazz, warm female solo voice with soft choir, upright bass, piano, brushed drums, saxophone, mellow, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
We hold the spirit of faith in hand
Believing what is written and planned
Speaking out because we believe
The truth that the heart is meant to receive

[Chorus]
Our outer self is wasting away
But the inner self is renewed day by day
Our light affliction is momentary
Producing an eternal weight of glory

[Verse]
We do not lose heart in the test
But look on what is unseen and blessed
The seen is temporary and fades
The unseen remains in the eternal shades

[Chorus]
Our outer self is wasting away
But the inner self is renewed day by day
Our light affliction is momentary
Producing an eternal weight of glory

[Bridge]
Raising us up with Jesus to go
Presenting us in the light and glow
For your sake the grace overflows
Thanksgiving abounding to God’s repose

[Chorus]
Our outer self is wasting away
But the inner self is renewed day by day
Our light affliction is momentary
Producing an eternal weight of glory

[Outro]
Fixing our eyes on what is unseen
The temporary ends but the eternal is keen
